name: California
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. California's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): Cape Mendocino in the west, the Mexican border at Tijuana/Imperial Beach in the south, Oregon in the north, the Colorado River in the east. The Channel Islands (San Clemente is the southernmost at ~32.8) and the Farallones are inside the box. Open Pacific west of Cape Mendocino and south of the border is trimmed; the Pacific off the southern and central coast inside the box cannot be trimmed with a rectangle, and the box takes in parts of Nevada, Arizona and Baja California. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-ca.
